tasks.title: Populate procedure_artifacts.wire_report on the live dispatch WIRE_UP turn (runtime producer)
acceptance_criteria: On a dispatch-mode run_chat_turn parked at WIRE_UP, when procedure_artifacts records the built module's rel-path under 'wire_module_rel' and no 'wire_report' is present yet, the runtime calls harness.wire_up.check_wired(repo_root, rel) and writes rec['procedure_artifacts']['wire_report'] = {'live_importers': list(result.importers), ...} BEFORE the gate runs that turn
The producer runs only for mode == 'dispatch' and phase == 'WIRE_UP'; all other modes/phases are byte-for-byte unchanged
A wired module (non-empty importers) advances the FSM WIRE_UP -> RESTORE that same turn; an orphan (empty importers) holds WIRE_UP (Blocked)
When neither 'wire_report' nor 'wire_module_rel' is recorded, check_wired is NOT called and the gate fails closed (existing behaviour preserved)
check_wired is imported LOCALLY inside run_chat_turn (no new module-level import); no new top-level function is added
all existing tests/overseer/test_turn_runner.py tests still pass
tasks.objective: Close the WIRE_UP gate's missing-producer gap: have run_chat_turn compute the reachability report at runtime (via check_wired) and populate procedure_artifacts.wire_report so the live dispatch FSM RUNS the orphan gate instead of fail-closing on a missing report.

spec.objective: Close the WIRE_UP gate's missing-producer gap: have run_chat_turn compute the reachability report at runtime (via harness.wire_up.check_wired) and populate rec['procedure_artifacts']['wire_report'] so the live dispatch FSM RUNS the orphan gate instead of fail-closing on a missing report.
functional_requirements: Inside the existing run_chat_turn procedure block (the `if _procedure is not None and _procedure_state is not None and mode in _registry:` branch), AFTER the line that computes `phase = st.phase or (proc.phases[0].name if proc.phases else '')` and BEFORE the line `if gate_runner is not None:`, insert a wire_report producer step.
The producer fires ONLY when `mode == 'dispatch' and phase == 'WIRE_UP'`.

It reads `_arts = rec.get('procedure_artifacts') or {}` and `_rel = _arts.get('wire_module_rel')`. It acts only when `_arts.get('wire_report') is None and _rel` (both truthy): otherwise it does nothing (an already-recorded wire_report is respected; an absent rel leaves the gate to fail closed).

When it acts, it does a LOCAL import `from harness.wire_up import check_wired` (NOT a module-level import) and computes `_wr = check_wired(repo_root, _rel)`, then writes a fresh dict back: `_arts = dict(_arts); _arts['wire_report'] = {'live_importers': list(_wr.importers), 'wired': bool(_wr.wired), 'reason': _wr.reason, 'module_rel': _rel}; rec['procedure_artifacts'] = _arts`.

The whole producer is wrapped so any failure is non-fatal: a try/except around the import+compute+write that swallows Exception (mirroring the existing import-safe try/except idiom already used elsewhere in this function), so a bad rel never breaks the turn.

Because the producer runs before `gate_runner(mode, phase, rec, state_dir)`, the SAME-turn gate reads the freshly populated rec['procedure_artifacts']['wire_report'] and advances (wired) or holds (orphan) accordingly. No other line of run_chat_turn changes.
spec.interfaces: run_chat_turn(store, cid, user_text, *, config, repo_root, state_dir, logs_dir, rewind_to_index=None, timeout=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SEC, seams=None, gate_runner=None, tmux_seams=None) -> dict. Unchanged signature/return. New internal behaviour: for dispatch/WIRE_UP it produces rec['procedure_artifacts']['wire_report'] from harness.wire_up.check_wired(repo_root, rel) -> WireResult(wired: bool, importers: list[str], reason: str, fix_hint: str), remapping WireResult.importers -> report key 'live_importers' (the key overseer.gates.wired reads).
edge_cases: mode=='dispatch', phase=='WIRE_UP', wire_module_rel present, wire_report absent -> check_wired called; wire_report populated with live_importers=list(importers); same-turn gate advances (importers non-empty) or holds (empty).
wire_report already present -> producer does NOT overwrite it and does NOT call check_wired.
wire_module_rel absent -> producer is a no-op; check_wired NOT called; gate fails closed via the existing _missing path (phase held).
Any mode other than 'dispatch', or any phase other than 'WIRE_UP' -> producer is a no-op (existing behaviour preserved exactly).
check_wired raises -> swallowed by try/except; turn proceeds; gate fails closed (no wire_report written).
non_goals: Do NOT change harness.wire_up.check_wired, overseer.gates.wired, overseer.gate_runner, the procedure registry, or the orchestrator accept path.
Do NOT add a new top-level function or a new module-level import -- the check_wired import MUST be local to run_chat_turn (inside the producer block).
Do NOT instruct the agent to record wire_module_rel here (the agent-side marker emission is a SEPARATE follow-on leaf); this leaf only CONSUMES an already-recorded wire_module_rel.
No new agent/process/network call. Preserve every existing run_chat_turn behaviour and every test in tests/overseer/test_turn_runner.py.
This is an integration edit to a single EXISTING symbol (run_chat_turn) in an existing module.
spec.implementation_notes:
EDIT the EXISTING file overseer/turn_runner.py (it is staged in inbox/targets -- read its current structure). ONE symbol changes: the top-level function run_chat_turn. Emit a single symbol patch that reproduces run_chat_turn IN FULL with exactly the producer block inserted (do not truncate the function body; reproduce every existing line). Insertion point: the procedure block begins with `if _procedure is not None and _procedure_state is not None and mode in _registry:` followed by `proc = _registry[mode]`, `st = _procedure_state.load_state(cid, state_dir=state_dir)`, `phase = st.phase or (proc.phases[0].name if proc.phases else '')`, then `if gate_runner is not None:`. Insert the producer AFTER the `phase = ...` line and BEFORE the `if gate_runner is not None:` line, indented to match (it is inside the `if ... mode in _registry:` block). Insert exactly:

        # --- wire_report producer (dispatch WIRE_UP) -------------------------
        # Before the 'wired' gate runs this turn, compute the reachability
        # report for the just-built module so the gate runs the REAL
        # check_wired at runtime instead of fail-closing on a missing report.
        # The built module's rel-path is read from the agent-recorded artifact
        # 'wire_module_rel'; the runtime computes reachability itself (the agent
        # cannot fake it). Fail-safe: any error leaves the gate to fail closed.
        if mode == 'dispatch' and phase == 'WIRE_UP':
            _arts = rec.get('procedure_artifacts') or {}
            _rel = _arts.get('wire_module_rel')
            if _arts.get('wire_report') is None and _rel:
                try:
                    from harness.wire_up import check_wired as _check_wired
                    _wr = _check_wired(repo_root, _rel)
                    _arts = dict(_arts)
                    _arts['wire_report'] = {
                        'live_importers': list(_wr.importers),
                        'wired': bool(_wr.wired),
                        'reason': _wr.reason,
                        'module_rel': _rel,
                    }
                    rec['procedure_artifacts'] = _arts
                except Exception:
                    pass

Do NOT add any module-level import of check_wired -- the local `from harness.wire_up import check_wired as _check_wired` inside the try is REQUIRED (a new module-level import would be a new top-level symbol and fail auto-commit). Do NOT cite line numbers. Keep the rest of run_chat_turn byte-for-byte identical. The committed oracle tests/overseer/test_wire_report_producer.py is authoritative -- your code MUST make it pass while keeping tests/overseer/test_turn_runner.py green.

non-dispatch / non-WIRE_UP turns unchanged (existing test_turn_runner.py suite stays green)
